update_policy: Curated defense guidance. New external advisories are NOT executable scanning rules until reviewed and tested.

incidents.title: Next.js middleware authorization bypass
incidents.plain_english: A locked door in the hallway could be skipped. Each private room needs its own lock too.
incidents.technical_lesson: Enforce authorization at every protected server handler, not only at a middleware boundary; upgrade affected Next.js releases.
incidents.test_plan: For each protected API route, test requests without a session and as a user who does not own the requested resource. Confirm server-side authorization denies both.

incidents.title: React Server Components remote code execution
incidents.plain_english: A bug in a building block could let a stranger give instructions to the server.
incidents.technical_lesson: Update vulnerable React Server Components packages and affected dependent frameworks; check lockfiles, not only manifest ranges.
incidents.test_plan: Verify installed versions using lockfile and OSV; after upgrade run functional and server integration tests.

incidents.title: npm Shai-Hulud supply-chain compromise
incidents.plain_english: A useful building block someone downloaded was secretly changed to steal keys.
incidents.technical_lesson: Pin and review dependencies, restrict installation scripts and build-time permissions, rotate leaked tokens, and isolate build credentials.
incidents.test_plan: Scan lockfiles, inspect newly introduced packages and lifecycle scripts, and confirm build jobs have least-privilege credentials.
